name: MESTRON
recent: Mestron 近期持续在公开市场进行股份回购，几乎每隔数日就有回购公告。2026 年 10 月底，其子公司获得 SEDA 批准，扩大位于 Kelantan 的 Gua Musang 沼气发电设施产能。同期，大股东 Lim Hock San 出现持股权益申报，董事 Por Teong Eng 在 9 月于场外减持 130 万股。
notable: 子公司获得 SEDA 批准，扩大位于 Kelantan 的 Gua Musang 沼气发电设施产能。
公司持续在公开市场进行股份回购。
大股东 Lim Hock San 出现持股权益申报 (Section 137)。
risks: 董事 Por Teong Eng 于 2026 年 9 月 22 日以每股 RM0.090 间接减持 130 万股。
董事在闭门期前申报有意交易公司股份。

Mestron Unit Obtains SEDA Approval To Expand Biogas Power Generation Facility In Kelantan

recent_en: In late October 2026, its subsidiary obtained SEDA approval to expand the biogas power generation facility in Gua Musang, Kelantan. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Lim Hock San filed a notice of interest, and director Por Teong Eng disposed of 1.3 million shares outside closed period in September.
notable_en: Subsidiary obtained SEDA approval to expand the biogas power generation facility in Gua Musang, Kelantan.
Substantial shareholder Lim Hock San filed a notice of interest (Section 137).
risks_en: Director Por Teong Eng disposed of 1.3 million indirect shares at RM0.090 per share on 22 September 2026.
Directors filed notices of intention to deal during the closed period.
